name: FrogNano-4B-2609
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-23. RL-only post-train of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (card release date 22-SEP-2026; HF repo created 2026-09-17 - the 5-day split is the card's stated release vs the upload, both recorded). Same config.json as the base, so the architecture block is inherited. Derived here: active_params_b = params_b = 4.66B (dense, no expert keys in config); flops_per_token_active = 6 * active_params. safetensors.total is 4659865088, a 5.1% overhang over the base's 4.66B because the checkpoint keeps the inherited (never post-trained) vision tower. kv_cache_bytes_per_token 32768 covers only the 8 full-attention layers out of 32; the rest are Gated-DeltaNet linear attention with constant-size state. Training was pure RL over ~1,500 TaskPilot-generated synthetic SWE environments with executable test rewards and the five-tool Leaf harness - no distillation from a stronger model, which makes the SWE-bench Verified delta (39.4 -> 61.5 Avg@3) a clean RL-scaling datapoint rather than a trajectory-copy artefact. Card explicitly disclaims general language/math/multilingual gains; upstream Qwen3.5-4B numbers must not be attributed to it.

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Verified
benchmarks.config: Card prose (section 2, Evaluation): FrogNano Avg@3 resolution 61.5% vs its own base Qwen3.5-4B Avg@3 39.4% on the SAME Leaf five-tool harness (150 interaction steps, ~131K interaction context, temperature 0.6, repetition penalty 1.0, official per-benchmark verifier). +22.1 pt over five RL iterations (49.1/53.1/56.7/59.1/61.5). Pass@3 71.0 is printed separately in Appendix C and is NOT comparable to Avg@3, so it is not recorded as this row.

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Pro
benchmarks.config: Card prose: Avg@3, held-out test set (731 tasks, 11 repos, Python/JS/TS/Go), same Leaf harness and 150-step budget. No base-model row printed for this benchmark, so this is not a delta.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
benchmarks.config: Card prose: Avg@3, held-out (89 tasks), automated grading of final container state, Leaf harness. No base row printed.

benchmarks.name: PatchEval-Verified
benchmarks.config: Card prose: Avg@3, held-out (230 CVE repair cases, 2015-2025). No base row printed. LOSS vs the catalog's best sub-5B agentic coding row on SWE-bench Verified (Spark-X2.6-4B 62.8, DeepSWE-style single run) - FrogNano is 1.3 pt behind that, and behind Dory-1.0-4B 61.8.
